5.description: [Pending Restart] [Seal of Ascension] The Seal of Ascension that previously would act as key to the Upper Blackrock Spire is now once again a normal ring. A new item the Forged Seal of Ascension now opens the Upper Blackrock Door and will go into your keyring, removing the need of having the ring with you everytime. Both the Ring and the Forged Seal will now be awarded by the quest Forged Seal o Ascension in Lower Blackrock Spire. Both items will be added to your vanity collection upon acquiring them. If you already owned a Forged Seal of Ascension  previously, you find it in your vanity collection under "Seal of Ascension" and the ring will create a Forged Seal of Ascension for you upon being equiped. In addition the Seal of Ascension now has an previously abandoned spell effect.
